name: The Easiest 2 Chords on Guitar
instructions: Some of the easiest guitar chords use just one or two fingers -- great for building confidence before tackling full four-finger shapes.
Practice switching between your new easy chord and the D chord from Day 2, alternating every four counts.
Keep your fretting fingers curved, not flat, so each finger presses only its own string.
Watch today's video for the easiest two-chord shapes to start with.
